#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Zero-product execution accounting; qualified logical leaves vs actual attempts."""
import argparse
import collections
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

ROOT=Path('<evidence>')
def sha(data):return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
def read(path):return json.loads(path.read_text())
def write(path,data):path.write_text(json.dumps(data,ensure_ascii=False,sort_keys=True,indent=2)+'\n')
def main():
    p=argparse.ArgumentParser();p.add_argument('--output',type=Path,required=True);a=p.parse_args();out=a.output
    summary=read(out/'summary.json');qualified=read(out/'commands.json')['commands']
    assert out.parent==ROOT and summary['completed'] and summary['all_passed']
    assert len(qualified)==summary['qualified_leaf_commands']==summary['expected_leaf_commands']
    assert all(c['actual_exit']==c['expected_exit'] for c in qualified)
    actual=[];attempts=[]
    if summary['stage']=='r07a':
        for name in ['r07a-qualified','r07a-qualified-corrected']:
            old=ROOT/name;commands=read(old/'commands.json')['commands'];old_summary=read(old/'summary.json')
            executed=[c for c in commands if c.get('execution_provenance')!='reused_completed_initial_attempt']
            actual.extend({'attempt':name,**c} for c in executed)
            attempts.append({'output':str(old),'source_mode':'retained original attempt; never rewritten','wrapper_wall_seconds':old_summary['wrapper_wall_seconds'],'matrix_actual_executed_leaves':len(executed),'qualified_successful_leaves':sum(c['actual_exit']==c['expected_exit'] for c in executed),'documents_sha256':{p.name:sha(p.read_bytes()) for p in old.glob('*.json')}})
        helper=read(ROOT/'standalone-helper-validation/commands.json')['commands']
        assert len(helper)==1 and helper[0]['actual_exit']==0
        actual.extend({'attempt':'standalone-helper-validation',**c} for c in helper)
        attempts.append({'output':str(ROOT/'standalone-helper-validation'),'classification':'Targeted pure-fixture public API child after observed standalone bootstrap error','actual_executed_leaves':1,'elapsed_seconds':helper[0]['elapsed_seconds']})
        launch=read(ROOT/'r07a-launch-quality-format-failure/attempt-failure.json')
        assert launch['product_leaf_commands']==0 and launch['actual_wrapper_exit']==1
        attempts.insert(0,{'output':str(ROOT/'r07a-launch-quality-format-failure'),'classification':launch['classification'],'wrapper_wall_seconds':launch['wrapper_elapsed_seconds'],'matrix_actual_executed_leaves':0,'actual_wrapper_exit':1,'raw_log_sha256':sha((ROOT/'r07a-launch-quality-format-failure/wrapper.log').read_bytes())})
    final_fresh=[c for c in qualified if c.get('execution_provenance')!='reused_completed_initial_attempt']
    actual.extend({'attempt':out.name,**c} for c in final_fresh)
    attempts.append({'output':str(out),'wrapper_wall_seconds':summary['wrapper_wall_seconds'],'actual_executed_leaves':len(final_fresh),'qualified_logical_leaves':len(qualified),'reused_completed_leaves':len(qualified)-len(final_fresh)})
    unknown=[c for c in actual if c['actual_exit'] is None]
    failed=[c for c in actual if c['actual_exit']!=c['expected_exit']]
    if summary['stage']=='r07a':
        assert len(qualified)==155 and len(actual)==157 and len(failed)==1 and failed[0]['label']=='public-current' and failed[0]['actual_exit']==1 and not unknown
        assert [x['label'] for x in actual if x.get('label')=='L0-default'].count('L0-default')==5
        assert len(final_fresh)==149
    if summary['stage']=='r07a-perf':
        assert len(qualified)==126 and len(actual)==126 and len(final_fresh)==126 and not failed and not unknown
    for c in actual:
        assert c['elapsed_seconds']>=0
    accounting={'schema_version':1,'stage':summary['stage'],'all_qualification_passed':True,'qualified_logical_leaf_commands':len(qualified),'all_attempts_actual_completed_leaf_commands':len(actual),'all_attempts_failed_standalone_helper_leaves':len(failed),'unknown_leaf_commands':len(unknown),'qualified_exit_distribution':dict(collections.Counter(str(c['actual_exit']) for c in qualified)),'all_attempts_actual_exit_distribution':dict(collections.Counter(str(c['actual_exit']) for c in actual)),'qualified_leaf_seconds':round(sum(c['elapsed_seconds'] for c in qualified),6),'all_attempts_actual_leaf_seconds':round(sum(c['elapsed_seconds'] for c in actual),6),'extra_actual_seconds':round(sum(c['elapsed_seconds'] for c in actual)-sum(c['elapsed_seconds'] for c in qualified),6),'wrapper_policy':'Single fresh R07-A perf follow-up matrix: every native/product leaf counts once. Wrapper wall time is independently retained and never added to leaf total. No previous R07-A executions or failures count for R07-A perf follow-up. Expected LlamaFactory default fail-on exit1 remains qualified.','leaf_scope':'Listed native/product validation matrix commands and explicitly requested bounded helper check; read-only inventory/prerequisite checks are infrastructure, not matrix leaves.','attempts':attempts,'actual_commands':actual,'qualified_summary_sha256':sha((out/'summary.json').read_bytes()),'qualified_commands_sha256':sha((out/'commands.json').read_bytes()),'final_comparisons_sha256':sha((out/'comparisons.json').read_bytes())}
    write(out/'execution-accounting.json',accounting)
    timings=[]
    by_key={(c['name'],c['label']):c for c in qualified}
    for (name,label),current in by_key.items():
        peer=None
        if label=='public-current':peer='public-frozen'
        elif label=='L0-text-current':peer='L0-text-frozen'
        elif label.startswith('export-') and label.endswith('-current'):peer=label[:-len('current')]+'frozen'
        if peer:
            frozen=by_key[(name,peer)]
            timings.append({'name':name,'current_label':label,'frozen_label':peer,'input_scope':'Same pin and plain business control; current facts batch additionally contains two bounded Git/fallback pollution controls' if label=='public-current' and summary['stage']=='r07a' else 'Same root, command arguments and equivalent input bytes/state','current_seconds':current['elapsed_seconds'],'frozen_seconds':frozen['elapsed_seconds'],'observed_current_minus_frozen_seconds':round(current['elapsed_seconds']-frozen['elapsed_seconds'],6)})
    assert len(timings)==30
    write(out/'paired-timings.json',{'schema_version':1,'method':'Single current/frozen child executions with the same monitored DRIVER and equivalent input bytes/state. Each R07-A perf follow-up facts pair scans the same pin and plain business control. Text and four export template pairs use the same root/arguments and equivalent Git/artifact state. Observe times separately from product gold equality. No claim about unmonitored native performance or statistical stability; no repeated measurement.','records':timings})
    print(json.dumps({k:accounting[k] for k in ['qualified_logical_leaf_commands','all_attempts_actual_completed_leaf_commands','unknown_leaf_commands','qualified_leaf_seconds','all_attempts_actual_leaf_seconds','qualified_exit_distribution','all_attempts_actual_exit_distribution']}))

if __name__=='__main__':main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Portable complete evidence only. Never run product commands or alter old proof."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

REPO=Path('<implementation>')
ROOT=Path('<evidence>')

def sha(data):return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
def portable(v):
    if isinstance(v,str):
        for old,new in [(str(ROOT),'<evidence>'),('<S3A-evidence>','<S3A-evidence>'),(str(REPO.parent/'dogfooding'),'<pinned-sources>'),(str(REPO),'<implementation>'),('<S1A-evidence>','<S1A-evidence>'),('<S1B-evidence>','<S1B-evidence>'),('<S2-evidence>','<S2-evidence>'),('<S3A-session>','<S3A-session>'),('<workspace-owner-root>','<workspace-owner-root>'),('<desktop-owner-root>','<desktop-owner-root>')]:v=v.replace(old,new)
        return v
    if isinstance(v,list):return [portable(x) for x in v]
    if isinstance(v,dict):return {portable(k):portable(x) for k,x in v.items()}
    return v
def write(path,data):
    data=portable(data)
    assert data.get('schema_version')==1
    body=(json.dumps(data,ensure_ascii=False,sort_keys=True,indent=2)+'\n').encode('utf-8')
    for value in [str(ROOT),str(REPO),'<workspace-owner-root>','<desktop-owner-root>']:
        assert value.encode() not in body, 'Machine path in portable proof'
    assert not path.exists(), 'Refuse to overwrite existing retained proof'
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);path.write_bytes(body)

def main():
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser();parser.add_argument('--stage-output',type=Path,required=True);parser.add_argument('--destination',type=Path,required=True)
    args=parser.parse_args();out=args.stage_output;dest=args.destination
    assert out.parent==ROOT and out.is_dir()
    summary=json.loads((out/'summary.json').read_text())
    assert dest.resolve().parent==ROOT and dest.name==summary['stage']+'-portable', 'Portable packaging destination must be this stage owned /tmp directory'
    assert summary['completed'] and summary['all_passed'] and summary['product_bytes_unchanged_during_gate']
    assert summary['fresh_core_baseline_leaf_commands']==45 and summary['core_baseline_comparisons']==180
    assert summary['actual_leaf_commands']==summary['qualified_leaf_commands']==summary['expected_leaf_commands']
    assert summary['unknown_leaf_commands']==0 and len(summary['targets'])==5 and all(x['valid'] and x['full_gold_equal'] for x in summary['targets'])
    comparisons=json.loads((out/'comparisons.json').read_text())['comparisons']
    assert len(comparisons)==summary['comparison_count'] and all(c['equal'] for c in comparisons)
    commands=json.loads((out/'commands.json').read_text())['commands']
    assert len(commands)==summary['actual_leaf_commands']
    for c in commands:
        assert c['actual_exit']==c['expected_exit']
        for stream in ['stdout','stderr']:
            data=(out/'raw'/(c['name']+'-'+c['label']+'.'+stream)).read_bytes()
            assert sha(data)==c[stream+'_sha256'] and data.decode('utf-8')==c[stream]
    prefix=summary['stage']+'-gate-';written=[];private={}
    for path in sorted(out.glob('*.json')):
        data=json.loads(path.read_text());assert data['schema_version']==1
        name=prefix+path.name;write(dest/name,data);written.append(name);private[path.name]=sha(path.read_bytes())
    for directory in ['raw','monitors','generated','blocked']:
        rows=[]
        for p in sorted((out/directory).rglob('*')):
            if p.is_file():
                rel=str(p.relative_to(out/directory));body=p.read_bytes()
                rows.append({'path':rel,'original_bytes_sha256':sha(body),'byte_count':len(body),'encoding':'utf-8','complete_text':body.decode('utf-8')})
        assert rows
        name=prefix+directory+'-complete.json'
        write(dest/name,{'schema_version':1,'full_equality_proof':'Raw stdout/stderr and generated artifact original byte SHA are independently checked against every completed ledger command before portable path display. Complete content retained, no truncation. JSON audit only generated_at normalized for comparison; raw bytes preserved independently.','records':rows})
        written.append(name)
    write(dest/(prefix+'harness.json'),{'schema_version':1,'original_harness_sha256':sha((out/'harness.py').read_bytes()),'complete_source':(out/'harness.py').read_text(),'display_only':'Portable path placeholders; exact executable original retained privately.'})
    written.append(prefix+'harness.json')
    for filename in ['helper-selfcheck.json','prepared-plan.json','source-tree-oracle.json','frozen-source-inventory.json']:
        data=json.loads((ROOT/filename).read_text());name=prefix+filename
        write(dest/name,data);written.append(name)
    index={'schema_version':1,'stage':summary['stage'],'all_passed':True,'private_output':'<evidence>/'+out.name,'private_original_documents_sha256':private,'portable_documents_sha256':{name:sha((dest/name).read_bytes()) for name in sorted(written)},'normalization':'Presentation replaces known implementation/pin/evidence machine roots. Original complete byte hashes and all equality checks remain retained; no persisted product artifact path normalization.','resource_boundary':'Only offline Gate A; historical GPU/network/paid-API resource blockers remain unchanged.'}
    write(dest/(prefix+'evidence-index.json'),index)
    print(json.dumps({'schema_version':1,'portable_files':len(written)+1,'index':str(dest/(prefix+'evidence-index.json')),'index_sha256':sha((dest/(prefix+'evidence-index.json')).read_bytes()),'actual_leaves':len(commands),'comparisons':len(comparisons)}))

if __name__=='__main__':main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Verify actual AST-success traces against literal bounded business fixtures.

This postprocess reads only retained evidence and the owned four tiny fixtures.
It starts no product child, changes no gold, and never modifies original output.
"""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path('<evidence>')


def sha(data):
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('--output', type=Path, required=True)
    out = parser.parse_args().output
    assert out.parent == ROOT and out.name == 'r07a-perf-qualified'
    summary_bytes = (out / 'summary.json').read_bytes()
    summary = json.loads(summary_bytes)
    assert summary['stage'] == 'r07a-perf' and summary['completed'] and summary['all_passed']
    assert summary['qualified_leaf_commands'] == summary['actual_leaf_commands'] == 126
    commands = json.loads((out / 'commands.json').read_bytes())['commands']
    by_label = {c['label']: c for c in commands if c['name'] == 'boundary'}
    cases = [str(n) + '-' + mode for n in [499, 500, 501] for mode in ['text', 'json', 'verbose']]
    cases += ['501-selected-syntax-skip']
    assert set(by_label) == set(cases) | {'frozen-complete-oracle'}
    checks = []
    inputs = []
    for case in ['499', '500', '501', '501-mixed']:
        count = 501 if case == '501-mixed' else int(case)
        base = out / 'boundaries' / case
        files = sorted(base.iterdir())
        expected_paths = [f'p-{n:03}.py' for n in range(count)]
        assert [p.name for p in files] == expected_paths
        rows = []
        for path in files:
            expected = b'def broken(:\n' if case == '501-mixed' and path.name == 'p-000.py' else b'import math\n'
            body = path.read_bytes()
            assert body == expected and not path.is_symlink()
            rows.append({'path': path.name, 'byte_count': len(body), 'original_bytes_sha256': sha(body)})
        inputs.append({'case': case, 'independent_candidate_count': count, 'files': rows})
    for label in cases:
        mixed = label == '501-selected-syntax-skip'
        count = 501 if mixed else int(label.split('-')[0])
        selected = [f'p-{n:03}.py' for n in range(min(count, 500))]
        successful = [p for p in selected if not (mixed and p == 'p-000.py')]
        command = by_label[label]
        assert command['actual_exit'] == command['expected_exit'] == 0
        monitor_path = out / 'monitors' / ('boundary-' + label + '.json')
        monitor_bytes = monitor_path.read_bytes()
        monitor = json.loads(monitor_bytes)
        for key, expected in [('attempted_target_parse_paths', selected), ('successful_target_parse_paths', successful)]:
            actual = monitor[key]
            checks.append({'label': label, 'field': key, 'actual': actual, 'expected': expected, 'equal': actual == expected, 'monitor_bytes_sha256': sha(monitor_bytes)})
        stderr = (out / 'raw' / ('boundary-' + label + '.stderr')).read_bytes()
        stdout = (out / 'raw' / ('boundary-' + label + '.stdout')).read_bytes()
        assert sha(stderr) == command['stderr_sha256'] and stderr.decode('utf-8') == command['stderr']
        assert sha(stdout) == command['stdout_sha256'] and stdout.decode('utf-8') == command['stdout']
        expected_stderr = b''
        if count == 501:
            expected_stderr = (
                b'scan: Python analysis incomplete: parsed 499 of 501 candidate files; selected 500 (limit 500), omitted 1. 1 selected files were not parsed. Missing signals may be in unanalysed files.\n'
                if mixed else
                b'scan: Python analysis incomplete: parsed 500 of 501 candidate files; selected 500 (limit 500), omitted 1. Missing signals may be in unanalysed files.\n'
            )
        checks.append({'label': label, 'field': 'source-backed-literal-stderr', 'actual': stderr.decode('utf-8'), 'expected': expected_stderr.decode('utf-8'), 'equal': stderr == expected_stderr, 'actual_original_bytes_sha256': sha(stderr), 'expected_literal_bytes_sha256': sha(expected_stderr)})
    assert len(checks) == 30 and all(c['equal'] for c in checks)
    report = {'schema_version': 1, 'stage': 'r07a-perf', 'all_passed': True, 'product_commands_executed': 0, 'additional_actual_leaf_commands': 0, 'scope': 'Pure evidence qualification of the ten already completed bounded current CLI children. No product rerun or current-output gold promotion.', 'independent_expectation': 'Four owned literal fixture trees: import math in every valid p-NNN.py; only mixed p-000.py is invalid syntax. Select sorted first500, then count actual successful ast.parse-return paths; never infer parsed from selected.', 'source_contract': {'accepted_patch_sha256': '8df82d2da2745615895ae06881312984cdaa65ca95c65b388379284810da9542', 'default_trigger': 'candidate greater than active file limit only'}, 'original_qualified_summary_sha256': sha(summary_bytes), 'source_input_trees': inputs, 'comparison_count': 30, 'checks': checks}
    path = out / 'boundary-AST-source-qualification.json'
    assert not path.exists()
    path.write_text(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, indent=2) + '\n')
    print(json.dumps({'all_passed': True, 'additional_product_children': 0, 'independent_comparisons': 30, 'report_sha256': sha(path.read_bytes())}))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
